career_goals: Master Strategic Talent Development and Talent Management leadership
Build end-to-end succession planning and critical-role risk frameworks
Champion People Analytics, predictive talent modeling, and L&D ROI
Pioneer AI-powered learning and digital workforce capability (AI Academy)
Advance toward Head / Director of Talent Management & Strategic HR

weekly_plan.why_matters: Transitioning from attendance metrics to skill-gap velocity and Power BI talent dashboards.

core_ld.title: CIPD Profession Map: Core Knowledge & Specialist Capability in L&D
core_ld.provider: CIPD (Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development)
core_ld.summary: Global international standard defining what HR, L&D, and Talent Management practitioners need to know, do, and deliver for business impact.
core_ld.why_relevant: Directly aligns TD Africa L&D capability architecture to internationally recognized CIPD standards.
core_ld.td_africa_application: Apply the frameworks from 'CIPD Profession Map: Core Knowledge & Specialist Capability in L&D' directly to refine TD Africa's annual TNA cycle, integrate modular lessons into SIMBA Spark microlearning, and deliver measurable capability metrics for executive reporting.

core_tm.title: How to Conduct High-Impact Talent Reviews & Succession Calibration (HBR)
core_tm.summary: Practical masterclass on calibrating employee performance versus potential, debiasing 9-box reviews, and securing executive alignment.
core_tm.why_relevant: Essential practical masterclass for leading TD Africa talent reviews.
core_tm.practical_application: Use this resource to pilot a structured 9-Box talent assessment and succession slate across one critical department at TD Africa.

core_broader.title: SHRM Body of Applied Skills & Knowledge (BASK) - Talent Management Framework
core_broader.summary: Authoritative competency framework defining behavioral competencies and HR functional knowledge for strategic leaders.
core_broader.why_relevant: Provides structural benchmarks for creating TD Africa's competency frameworks and assessment rubrics.

challenge.title: Draft a 9-Box Talent Review Calibration Grid for One Strategic Department
challenge.instructions: Map 5-8 key roles across Performance (Low/Med/High) vs Potential (Low/Med/High). Define one specific development action for each quadrant.

portfolio_evidence.description: A standardized executive framework for identifying critical talent, flight risks, and succession readiness.

three_actions.learn: Complete 'CIPD Profession Map: Core Knowledge & Specialist Capability in L&D' and 'How to Conduct High-Impact Talent Reviews & Succession Calibration (HBR)' (30-45 mins + 35 mins).
three_actions.apply: Draft a 9-Box Talent Review Calibration Grid for One Strategic Department (45 mins).
three_actions.capture: Save 'Succession Planning & 9-Box Review Template' to your professional career portfolio.

reflection_questions: What critical insight from this week's resources challenges our current approach at TD Africa?
How can the practical challenge deliverable be integrated into upcoming talent review or training cycles?
What behavioral shift in leadership or capability development did this study reveal?
weekly_plan.next_action: Complete the 'Draft a 9-Box Talent Review Calibration Grid for One Strategic Department' and archive the evidence in your portfolio before next Monday.
